meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
If you want to buy **kurta sets online in India**, the best brand depends on your use case: **Libas** for variety and everyday wear, **W for Woman** for office-ready coordinated sets, **Biba** for festive classics, and **Jaipur Kurti** for affordable printed daily wear.[1][2][3][9]

A practical short list is:

- **Libas** — strong all-rounder for straight cotton sets, A-line and Anarkali styles, and festive embroidered options.[3][17]
- **W for Woman** — a reliable choice for office wear and polished ethnic sets.[1]
- **Biba** — good for festive and family-function wear.[1][9]
- **Jaipur Kurti** — good if you want affordable everyday kurta sets and a wide variety of ethnic styles.[1][2]
- **House of Indya** — better if you prefer festive, fashion-forward looks.[1][20]
- **Aachho** — useful for printed festive kurta sets and mid-range pricing.[1][7]
- **Taneira** — a fit for premium fabrics and dressier sets.[1]

If you want one simple recommendation, **Libas** is the safest overall buy for most women shopping online in India because it offers the broadest mix of daily wear, office wear, and occasion styles.[1][3][17]

If you want, I can also narrow this down by **budget**, **occasion** (office/festive/wedding), or **fabric** (cotton/silk/georgette).
